summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Tetra Tech, Inc. reporting second fiscal quarter 2026 financial results and the declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.072 per share. Items 2.02 and 8.01 cover earnings release and dividend announcement, respectively. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation is involved. The filing is standard operating performance disclosure with no structural corporate event. It does not meet any special-situations category.
